name: nested yield calls
genfunc nested pull mixed
code:
def c1():
    yield 1
    yield 2

def c2():
    yield 10
    yield 20

def g():
    a = c1()
    b = c2()
    yield next(a)
    yield next(b)
    yield next(a)
    yield next(b)

print(list(g()))
